author: C. K. Porter
title: Enrollment at Grand Saline ISD schools decreased by 3.1% compared to previous school year - Tyler Reporter
text:
There were 1,176 students enrolled in Grand Saline ISD schools in the 2023-24 school year, 3.1% less than the previous year, according to the Texas Education Agency.
Of all the students welcomed in the 2023-24 school year, 50.6% were girls, and 49.4% were boys.
Data also shows that the majority of students were white, representing 68.4% of the district’s total enrollment.
Grand Saline ISD roughly covers schools within Van Zandt County with its main office in Grand Saline.
Among the five schools in Grand Saline ISD, Grand Saline High School recorded the highest enrollment of 337 students in the 2023-24 school year.
A recent study by WalletHub classified Texas as one of the least-educated states in the U.S., ranking it 41st out of 50 in educational quality and student outcomes.
Underfunding is a frequently cited challenge facing Texas’ school districts. According to a 2024 report from the Texas Education Agency, per-pupil funding has not increased since 2019, despite inflation rates rising by more than 20% since then.
“As a result, many districts in our very own Central Texas region are being forced to cut back on essential programs, services, consider school closures, and adopt deficit budgets just to provide students with the education that they deserve,” Hutto ISD Trustee James Matlock stated in an interview.

---|---|
